note: Working in concept_driven mode using .concept/ontology.yml as source of truth

derived_purpose.mission: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.
target_user: Application Developers building LLM-powered applications with GUI interfaces
AI Agent Developers creating specialized agents
Framework Developers building GUI backend implementations
AI Agents (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.) working with this codebase
derived_purpose.core_value: Seamless GUI-LLM integration with consistent state management, type safety, and clear semantics

core_functions.name: Centralized Conversation Management
core_functions.description: Interpreter component centralizes conversation flow, state management, and agent coordination

core_functions.name: State Consistency
core_functions.description: Enforce monotonic state transitions (INIT → RUNNING → STOP) through hard invariants

core_functions.name: Multi-Agent Support
core_functions.description: Role-based agent system with clear boundaries (AGENT_EXECUTOR, LLM_PLANNER, SUPERVISOR, etc.)

core_functions.name: Type Safety
core_functions.description: Enumerated message types (MESSAGE, CODE, CONFIRMATION, etc.) with strict validation

core_functions.name: Flexible Integration
core_functions.description: Abstract backend interface with pluggable implementations (Gradio, future frameworks)
